answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and strictly primary-region, which matches the March failover playbook more tightly than a global code fault. A release landed 2 hours ago and staging/canary practice means the bad build may exist only in primary, so failover could shed the regression without dropping writes. Rollback remains a live alternative on timing grounds; circuit breaking would fail customer writes and violate the objective. Peak settlement means a full cutover could stress the secondary, so shift a substantial but not total share and treat write loss and secondary saturation as open risks until b1/b2 archives are checked.
